title: Screaming Lines Adventures
gap: Prices for fishing trips not stated
blurb: Screaming Lines Adventures is a family-run fishing charter business in Key West, operated by four generations of the Estenoz family. They offer fishing trips in the pristine waters of the Florida Keys, sharing their extensive knowledge of local fishing spots, knots, tackle, and bait. Guests can expect to fish for species like mahi-mahi, snapper, wahoo, black fin tuna, king mackerel, and barracuda.
